About.metaDescription: Learn about the origin, mission, and model of the Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) A.C. of Puebla, Mexico.
About.heroDescription: A civil association from Puebla that brings together government, academia, and industry to make it easier to create and scale tech startups in Puebla.
About.originTitle: From active network to civil association
About.originDescription: The cluster has operated as a working network since 2021 and was formally consolidated in 2026.
About.originItem1Description: Business leaders, academics, and government agents begin collaborating on a regular basis to strengthen Puebla's entrepreneurial ecosystem.
About.originItem2Description: The Startup and Innovation Cluster (CSI) A.C. is established, with legal personality and defined governing bodies.
About.originItem3Description: The Ministry of Economic Development and Labor of the State of Puebla recognizes the cluster as an interlocutor of the innovation ecosystem.
About.originItem4Description: Swearing-in of the board and public presentation of the cluster before the business, academic, and government community.
About.originImageAlt: Launch gala and swearing-in ceremony of the cluster board, July 2026
About.missionDescription: Two commitments that guide every decision of the cluster.
About.missionCardText: Create the conditions for startups from Puebla to scale globally: connections between stakeholders, innovation infrastructure, and institutional support.
About.visionCardText: For Puebla to become a Latin American innovation benchmark, where launching a tech startup is as easy as opening a traditional business.
About.helixTitle: Government, academia, and industry at the same table
About.helixDescription: The cluster operates under the Triple Helix model: each stakeholder contributes resources, talent, and decision-making to accelerate the ecosystem.
About.helixImageAlt: Expanded Triple Helix model diagram with the role of each stakeholder
About.helixGovText: Provides a favorable regulatory framework, institutional recognition, and support programs for the ecosystem.
About.helixAcademyText: Universities and research centers contribute talent, applied science, and innovation spaces such as the CERHAN II Hub.
About.helixIndustryText: Local industry validates solutions, opens value chains, and supports startups in their scale-up.
About.ecosystemDescription: Public and simplified version of the cluster map, from local industry to strategic leadership.
About.ecosystemImageAlt: CSI ecosystem diagram, seven-level public version
About.level1Description: Companies from Puebla that demand innovation and open their value chains to startups.
About.level2Description: Training, attraction, and retention of the talent that fuels innovation projects.
About.level3Description: Physical spaces and laboratories of the CERHAN II Hub at the service of the ecosystem.
About.level4Description: Events, networks, and programs that keep the entrepreneurial community active.
About.level5Description: Development and validation of technological solutions for industry challenges.
About.level6Description: Access to capital, public calls, and funding instruments for scaling.
About.level7Description: The cluster's governing bodies that set direction, alliances, and the 2030 vision.
About.legalDescription: Registration information of the civil association, available for verification and contracting purposes.
